summary.intent: Enhance the summary TUI detail pane to show all available session data (scores, stats, files, tools, facets with evidence), fix the repo filter showing nothing, and add text selection/copy support.
summary.outcome: Implemented 4-box grouped layout (SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS) with all missing data; fixed repo filter by loading separate row sets per filter view; enabled highlight-copy via keyboard-only scrolling; fixed memory-loop outcome tracking logic which was incorrectly marking injected memories as ineffective; wired up the edit wizard intent in memory-loop TUI.

repo: The insights.db has 15 populated tables including sessions, tool_calls, files_touched, learnings, friction, failure_loops, repeated_user_instructions, missing_context_signals, skill_signals, review_rule_signals, codebase_patterns, implementation_rationale, tradeoffs.
Facet backfilling: sessions are initially stored with has_facets=0; memory-loop/improve/insights commands send condensed transcripts to an LLM to extract structured signals, then set has_facets=1.

The summary TUI loadSummarySessions loads only the 200 most recent sessions; when on a feature branch, none of these overlap with main-reachable checkpoint IDs, causing the repo filter to show nothing.

DeriveOutcomes outcome logic was inverted: injected memories appearing in post-injection negative evidence should be ineffective, but evidence from pre-injection sessions was incorrectly influencing the outcome; fix requires temporal split on LastInjectedAt.
The WizardIntentEdit case was missing from the memory_loop_cmd.go wizard handler switch; the interactive edit mode was stubbed with 'not yet implemented'.
tea.WithMouseCellMotion() captures all mouse events preventing terminal text selection; removing it restores highlight-copy while pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d provide keyboard-only detail pane scrolling.

code.finding: Rewrote renderDetailContent to use 4 grouped boxes: SUMMARY (scores/stats), CODE (files/tools/rationale/tradeoffs/patterns), LEARNINGS, SIGNALS (all facet types with evidence). Added renderSubSection helper with blank-line spacing between sub-sections, renderSignalsBox, renderCodeBox, formatDuration.

Replaced single m.rows with m.branchRows and m.repoRows; applyFilter selects the correct source slice based on active filter. Removed tea.WithMouseCellMotion() to allow text selection; detail pane scrolls via pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d.
Added loadRepoSessions helper that calls QueryByCheckpointIDs with reachable checkpoint IDs; passes repoRows separately to RunWithCurrentBranch alongside branchRows.
Added QueryByCheckpointIDs method to load sessions matching a set of checkpoint IDs, used for the repo filter view.

Fixed DeriveOutcomes: for injected records, split sessions into pre/post LastInjectedAt; only post-injection friction overlap signals ineffective; no post-injection friction overlap signals reinforced; zero post-injection sessions signals neutral.
Added WizardIntentEdit case in wizard handler; added editMemoryLoopWizardRequest function that opens a huh form pre-populated with record's title, body, and keywords, then calls EditRecord on submit.

workflow: Codex adversarial review companion hits ENOBUFS on large repos because its internal git diff buffer overflows; not usable on large monorepos.
When removing mouse capture from bubbletea TUI, verify all scroll paths still work via keyboard before committing.
For outcome/signal correctness bugs, write temporal test cases with explicit CreatedAt and LastInjectedAt values to avoid zero-value ambiguity.

friction: Codex adversarial review companion failed with ENOBUFS on both foreground and background runs due to repo size; review was skipped.
replace_all corrupted function call sites when used on short parameter tokens — required manual repair of renderSubSection call signatures.
First mouse-removal commit broke scroll entirely before the keyboard-only fallback was validated, requiring a follow-up fix.
Visual companion server startup required multiple attempts and was left running as a background process.
The brainstorming skill spawned many tracking tasks and had overhead before producing the actual design output.
open_items: The 'y copy' clipboard feature (copy entire detail pane) was added then removed in favor of highlight-copy; could be re-added as an opt-in if users want it.

DeriveOutcomesFromEvidence (the evidence-only variant used in some tests) now returns neutral for all cases since it has no temporal data; a separate evidence-based reinforcement signal path may be worth adding.
The memory-loop 'reinforced' outcome now requires post-injection sessions with no friction overlap; memories injected recently with few post-injection sessions will stay neutral indefinitely.
